name: Stats Lab
paper: Business Mathematics and Statistics for Managers
intro: Free, interactive tools for every unit of the B.B.A. paper Business Mathematics and Statistics for Managers. Enter a problem from your textbook or class, and each tool works it out step by step, the way you would by hand, so you can check your own working.

units.name: Measures of central tendency and dispersion

matrices.title: Matrix calculator
matrices.text: Addition, subtraction and multiplication with every entry worked out, the transpose, the determinant by expansion, the adjoint from the cofactors, and the inverse in exact fractions, checked by A × A⁻¹ = I.

cramer.title: Cramer's rule
cramer.text: Solves two or three simultaneous equations: Δ and each Δx, Δy, Δz written out, then x = Δx / Δ and so on. Says when Δ = 0 and the rule cannot be used.

percentages.title: Percentages, ratios, profit and loss
percentages.text: Percentages and percentage change, successive changes, profit and loss on cost price, discounts and marked price, dividing an amount in a ratio, and proportions.

interest.title: Simple and compound interest
interest.text: Simple and compound interest with yearly, half-yearly, quarterly or monthly compounding. Finds the interest, the amount, the principal, the rate or the time, with a year-by-year table.

speed-work.title: Time, speed, distance and work
speed-work.text: Average speed, trains passing a pole, a platform or each other, km/h and m/s, people or pipes working together, and men–days–hours problems.

probability.title: Permutations, combinations and probability
probability.text: nPr and nCr with the factors written out, arrangements of a word's letters, and simple probability with coins, dice, cards and a bag of balls, as exact fractions.

averages.title: Central tendency and dispersion
averages.text: Mean, median, mode, quartiles, range, quartile deviation, mean deviation, standard deviation and the coefficient of variation, for individual, discrete and continuous series.

correlation.title: Correlation
correlation.text: Karl Pearson's coefficient from deviations about the means, and Spearman's rank correlation with the correction for tied ranks, each with the full working table and a scatter diagram.

regression.title: Regression
regression.text: Both regression equations, Y on X and X on Y, from paired data or from the means, standard deviations and r. Estimates one variable from the other and draws both lines.

time-series.title: Time series trend
time-series.text: Trend by the semi-average method and by moving averages of any period (centred for an even period), with the trend values and a graph of the series and its trend.

index-numbers.title: Index numbers
index-numbers.text: Laspeyres, Paasche and Fisher's price index numbers with the p × q table, and the time reversal and factor reversal tests.
